simple.meaning: לוּז (Lûwz) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H3870). BibleIQ follows its 8 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Genesis, Joshua, Judges, beginning at Genesis 28:19. The surrounding context includes city, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name לוּז (H3870).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.
simple.summary: לוּז (Lûwz) / H3870 is traced through Genesis 28:19, Genesis 35:6, Genesis 48:3, Joshua 16:2 using generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: Luz , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H3870. Luz II. לוּז proper name, of a location 1. former name of Bethel Gen 28:19 (J), 35:6 (E), 48:3 (P), Josh 18:13 (twice in verse) (P), Judg 1:23 ; apparently distinct from Biblical לוּ֫זָה מִבֵּיתאֵֿל Josh 16:2 (J E; but ׳ל here perhaps explanatory gloss, see Di); ᵐ5 Λουζα , Gen 28:19 [Ουλαμ]μαυς 2 city in hands of Hittites Judg 1:26 (on conjectures as to site see GFM); ᵐ5 Λουζα . לוח (√ of following, meaning unknown; compare perhaps Arabic shine, gleam, flash (of star, lightning, etc.), or Syriac wipe out, efface with reference to smooth surface; but this = לחה ).
